es_uri.description: Base URI of your Elasticsearch cluster (e.g., http://es-cluster:9200). Used if ES_NODES is not specified.

es_nodes.description: List of specific node URIs to scrape (e.g., ['http://node1:9200', 'http://node2:9200']). Overrides ES_URI.

items.description: Full URI of an Elasticsearch node

es_username.description: Username for basic authentication to Elasticsearch (required if security features are enabled).

es_password.description: Password for basic authentication to Elasticsearch. Keep secret!

es_tls.description: Enable TLS (HTTPS) when connecting to Elasticsearch.

es_ca_cert.description: Absolute path to the CA certificate file used to verify Elasticsearch's TLS certificate (e.g., /etc/ssl/certs/es-ca.crt).

es_tls_skip_verify.description: Skip verification of Elasticsearch's TLS certificate. ⚠️ Only for testing — never in production.

es_client_cert.description: Absolute path to the client certificate for mutual TLS authentication (optional).

es_client_key.description: Absolute path to the client private key for mutual TLS authentication (optional).

cluster_health.description: Collect cluster health metrics (status, number of nodes, etc.).

indices_stats.description: Collect per-index statistics (docs, store size, queries, etc.).

nodes_stats.description: Collect per-node JVM, OS, and transport metrics.

shards_stats.description: Collect per-shard metrics. ⚠️ Can be expensive on large clusters with many shards.

snapshots.description: Collect snapshot repository and snapshot status metrics.

circuit_breakers.description: Collect Elasticsearch circuit breaker stats (memory usage limits).

thread_pools.description: Collect thread pool size, queue, and activity metrics per node.

index_templates.description: Collect index template stats (matching patterns, order, etc.).

ingest_pipelines.description: Collect ingest pipeline stats (processors, failures, etc.).

features.description: Collect feature usage metrics (e.g., machine learning, watchlists).

extra_labels.description: List of key=value labels to attach to every metric (e.g., ['env=prod', 'team=observability']).

http_timeout.description: HTTP request timeout to Elasticsearch in seconds. Increase for slow or large clusters.

listen_port.description: Port on which the exporter exposes its /metrics endpoint.

listen_host.description: Network interface to bind the exporter to (e.g., 127.0.0.1 to restrict locally).

log_level.description: Verbosity of exporter logs (debug for troubleshooting).

metric_filtering.description: Enable experimental filtering of metrics by regex patterns.

metric_filters.description: List of regex patterns; metrics matching any pattern are excluded from output.

items.description: Perl-compatible regular expression (regex) to match metric names

exclude_indices.description: List of index name patterns (glob or regex) to skip when collecting indices stats.

exclude_node_roles.description: List of node roles to exclude (e.g., 'master', 'data'). Only core roles: master, data, ingest, ml.

items.description: Elasticsearch node role to exclude from stats

ilm.description: Collect Index Lifecycle Management (ILM) policy and phase metrics.

data_streams.description: Collect data stream stats (backing indices, generation, size).
